## Milestone 1 - Task 3.1: API Request Builder

Consumes the Planner Contract produced by 01-ingestion (docs/contracts/planner-contract.md) and transforms a valid `api` test case into the standard API Request Contract (docs/contracts/api-request-contract.md).

This workflow only *prepares* the request - it never sends one. There is no HTTP Request node here. Execution is the job of the future HTTP Executor workflow (Task 3.2), which is out of scope for this task.

Invalid input produces the shared ERROR payload (docs/contracts/error-payload.md) instead - it is never silently dropped.

## Task 3.1 design notes

- `steps` is currently the only place a test case encodes an HTTP method + endpoint (e.g. "POST /signup with a 5-character password", per docs/architecture/milestone-1.md section 6's own worked example). `Validate Test Case` parses it with a fixed, deterministic pattern - no AI, no guessing. Optional explicit `test_case.method` / `test_case.endpoint` fields override the parse if present.
- `authentication.credentials` never holds a real secret. This workflow only resolves which auth *strategy* applies (`docs/contracts/api-request-contract.md`); the workflow that actually executes the HTTP call is responsible for attaching real credentials via n8n's own credential store (ADR 002), never from data flowing through this contract.

nodes.name: HTTP Executor
nodes.notes: Hand-off boundary to the HTTP Executor workflow (Task 3.2, not yet built). Receives either an API Request Contract (docs/contracts/api-request-contract.md) or an ERROR payload (docs/contracts/error-payload.md). No HTTP call happens in this workflow.
